headline: A 2017 executive order directing federal agencies to change how they handle border security and immigration enforcement.
what_it_does: Based on its title, this order tells federal agencies to make changes to security at the US border and to how immigration laws are enforced. No summary was provided, so the specific actions, programs, and funding it directs cannot be described here.

who_it_affects.how: The order appears to direct these agencies to change how they carry out border security and immigration enforcement.

who_it_affects.group: People crossing or trying to cross the US border
who_it_affects.how: They may be affected by any changes to border security that the order directs.

who_it_affects.group: Immigrants living in the United States
who_it_affects.how: They may be affected by any changes in how immigration laws are enforced.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed January 25, 2017; the provided material does not state a separate effective date.
